name: youtube-video-summarization-benchmark
description: A benchmark for summarizing YouTube videos, typically using video transcripts (and in some cases audio/video features) to generate concise summaries of video content. It measures summarization quality across diverse video genres and lengths, comparing generated summaries to references with automatic metrics and occasionally human evaluation.
reputation: A community-contributed dataset on Hugging Face used for research and model prototyping, but not yet a widely standard benchmark.
